{{Quote|I apologize for such a rude interruption. Please let us continue.|Bec Lawise, following the arrest of Lux Bonteri|<ref name="A Friend in Need" />}}
[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] '''Bec Lawise''' was a [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Separatist Congress Leader/Legends|Separatist Congress Leader]] of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A vocal supporter of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Lawise acted as the speaker of the Parliament, presiding over congress sessions on [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]] alongside Dooku, the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]]. Lawise was present when Senator [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] secured the passage of a [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|bill]] to open peace negotiations with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a move that ultimately resulted in the [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|derailment]] of the proposal and her [[Death/Legends|murder]], both due to Dooku's machinations. Lawise later served on a three-member Parliament delegation at a [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|peace conference]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], where they met with Republic representatives to pursue a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] end to the war. The deliberations were interrupted by Mina Bonteri's son, [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux]], who publicly accused Dooku of [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] and led Lawise to have the delegation's [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] arrest the young man.

Alongside Republic Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], Lawise traveled to [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]] on behalf of the Confederacy to recognize the inauguration of [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] as the head of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Dooku soon became involved in the proceedings, manipulating Clovis into absolving the Confederacy's financial debts and then overseeing a [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|Separatist invasion]] of Scipio. When Lawise objected to Dooku's course of action, particularly to the Head of State's direct arrest of Amidala, Dooku engineered Lawise's death, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|maneuver]] Amidala into gunning him down.

==Biography==
===Steps toward peace===
{{Quote|It has come to my attention that my mother was murdered by Count Dooku in cold blood.''"<br />"''That is a lie! Remove this traitor immediately.|Lux Bonteri and Bec Lawise, during the peace conference on Mandalore|<ref name="A Friend in Need" />}}
The [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Bec Lawise<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> lived during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Entering the realm of [[Politics/Legends|politics]], Lawise disputed the Republic's rule over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> a separatist government [[Raxus Address/Legends|formed]] by the former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Lawise became a [[Senator/Legends|delegate]] of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]], eventually being made [[Separatist Congress Leader/Legends|Separatist Congress Leader]] and, hence, the speaker of the Parliament. He thus filled a leadership position in the legislative body alongside<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /><ref name="Explore: Crisis at the Heart">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep607|text="Crisis at the Heart" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Dooku, who served as Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Confederacy [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|initiated]] full-scale conflict with the Republic in what became known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="NEC" /> While the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederacy military]] fought with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] for supremacy in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] theater of war, Lawise presided over congress sessions at the<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> [[Separatist Senate Building/Legends|Separatist Senate Building]],<ref name="Explore: Heroes on Both Sides">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep310|text="Heroes on Both Sides" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> which was located in a [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus city|large city]] on the Confederate [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]].<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>

[[File:BecLawiseLetsContinue-AFIN.png|thumb|left|250px|Lawise continues the peace conference on Mandalore following Bonteri's arrest.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the war's second year,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Date">{{TCWdates|310}}</ref> Senator [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]],<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mina">{{SWE|characters|minabonteri|Mina Bonteri}}</ref> working with Republic Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] toward an end to the fighting, introduced a [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|bill]] to open peace negotiations with the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]]. With Lawise overseeing the debate of the bill alongside Dooku, who was present via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], several senators spoke in support of and opposition to Bonteri's proposal,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> including [[Kerch Kushi/Legends|Kerch Kushi]] and [[Voe Atell/Legends|Voe Atell]], respectively.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> When Dooku called for a voice vote as per the [[Bylaws of Independent Systems/Legends|Bylaws of Independent Systems]], the bill passed by a majority, and the Parliament's offer for peace was extended to the Republic. Yet it ultimately failed due to the machinations of Dooku, who was secretly a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|member]] of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] and sought to continue the war to further the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] agenda. To that end, Dooku sanctioned a [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|terrorist attack]] on the Republic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] without Parliament approval, leading the Republic Senate to reject the offer of peace.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> Dooku also had Bonteri [[Attack on Confederate people/Legends|murdered]]<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep414|text="A Friend in Need" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> and attributed her [[Death/Legends|death]] to a Republic attack, using it as a reason to withdraw the Confederacy's overture for negotiations.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>

Even without Bonteri, the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] process continued. The Parliament agreed to send a delegation to a [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|peace conference]] with Republic officials on the neutral world of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Lawise consented to serve on the delegation with Voe Atell and Senator [[Amita Fonti/Legends|Amita Fonti]], and they proceeded to Mandalore's capital [[City/Legends|city]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], aboard a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]]. [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] hosted the Separatist and Republic delegations at Sundari's [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|royal palace]].<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> Though required to be unarmed per [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] law,<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" /> Lawise and his colleagues brought [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] as [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]], while [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]] served as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] for the Republic deputation, consisting of Senators [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> and led by Padmé Amidala.<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" /> After Amidala opened the deliberations, Atell, speaking for the others, pushed for the Republic to confer political legitimacy on the Confederacy,<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> a recurring issue since the latter's birth as a separate state.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> Though Amidala and her party hesitated to meet Atell's demand, the talks were then interrupted by the uninvited arrival of [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]],<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> who had succeeded his [[Parent/Legends|mother]], Mina, as the senator of Onderon<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mina" /> before recently resigning his Parliament seat. Kryze granted the young Bonteri permission to speak, much to Lawise and Atell's chagrin.<ref name="A Friend in Need" />

Taking to the podium, Bonteri accused Dooku of having his mother murdered, a claim that Lawise immediately met with opposition. The Separatist Congress Leader denounced Bonteri's remarks as lies and had the security [[Droid/Legends|droids]] arrest the young man. Once Bonteri had been removed from the room, Lawise apologized on the Separatists' behalf for the interruption and reopened the floor to discussion. However, the negotiations broke down shortly thereafter<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> on account of shadowy interests on both sides.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mothma">{{SWE|characters|mon-mothma|Mon Mothma}}</ref> In addition, Bonteri escaped from custody with the assistance of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="A Friend in Need" />

===Financial talks on Scipio===
{{Dialogue|Dooku|Hasn't she joined our cause? Clovis here told me how instrumental you were in getting him to power.|Amidala|If I had ''known''&hellip;|Dooku|Either you're with us, or you're against us. ''[To a pair of battle droids]'' Arrest her.|Lawise|We can't do this, Dooku. The Separatist Senate will never approve. No. No. No!|Amidala|No!|attr=Dooku manipulates Padmé Amidala into gunning down Bec Lawise|src=<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />}}
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the final year of the war,<ref name="FF-2014 46: Scipio" /> the Confederate government voted to recognize a new leader of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]: [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]], who had ousted the previous leadership, the corrupt [[Core Five/Legends|Core Five]], with the secret aid of Count Dooku.<ref name="The Rise of Clovis">{{TCW|The Rise of Clovis}}</ref> Separatist and Republic delegations proceeded to the Banking Clan's headquarters on the planet [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]] to bear witness to the internal transfer of power. Lawise and a squad of BX-series droid commandos arrived at Scipio's [[Main Vault/Legends|Main Vault]] fortress ahead of Clovis, who was returning from Coruscant with Padmé Amidala after receiving the formal approval of the Republic Senate. Once Clovis and Amidala had disembarked from their [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Scipio)|''Consular''-class cruiser]], Lawise and a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] greeted Clovis, who explained that only one delegate from both the Republic and the Separatists&mdash;Amidala and Lawise, respectively&mdash;would be allowed inside the Main Vault's neutral zone to monitor the exchange proceedings. Lawise complied and ordered his squad of droid commandos to remain outside, while Amidala did the same for her [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]]. Lawise and Amidala arrived at the Main Vault with Clovis just as a [[Unidentified Muun judge/Legends|Muun judge]] was completing his sentencing of the Core Five, whom Clovis had found to be complicit in an embezzlement scam that had depleted the banks. After the Core Five was taken into custody, the Muun government transferred control of the Banking Clan to Clovis, and Lawise and Amidala applauded from the sidelines.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />

[[File:AmidalaShootsLawise-CATH.png|thumb|right|250px|Dooku instigates Lawise's murder by redirecting Amidala's blaster with the Force.]]
Dooku took a proactive role in the ensuing proceedings, as part of a plot to seize control of the banks and absolve the Separatists' debts to the Banking Clan. He outright refused on the Separatists' behalf to pay the interest on their loans, forcing Clovis to instead raise interest rates on the Republic to avoid total collapse. At the next meeting in the main rotunda, Lawise and Amidala witnessed Clovis's announcement that&mdash;under the guise of stabilization&mdash;the Banking Clan would be implementing an interest rate height for the Republic. Amidala was shocked that Clovis was reneging on his promise of neutrality; Lawise stood by without saying a word as Amidala's objections fell on deaf [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />

Dooku executed the next stage in his plan: arriving at Scipio with a full [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] from the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]], he had his forces [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|obliterate]] the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] garrison outside the Main Vault, thus publicly implicating Clovis in an alliance with the Confederacy. Following Dooku's invasion of Scipio, Lawise and Dooku met with Clovis in the latter's [[Clovis' office/Legends|office]] atop the Main Vault fortress, where they were soon joined by a pair of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] who brought along Amidala as a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]. Dooku ordered Amidala arrested, but Lawise protested, citing that the Separatist Parliament would never approve so brash a move. When Amidala stole an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]] from one of the droids and pointed it at Dooku, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] called upon [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], using it to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] aim Amidala's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] at Lawise. The Separatist Congress Leader could only utter a few words of shock before Dooku forced Amidala to pull the trigger, killing Lawise. The Head of State thereafter withdrew his [[Navy/Legends|naval]] forces from Scipio just as a Republic fleet arrived to mount a planetary invasion.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Do you think our friend is up to the task?''"<br />"''There are few men I have met in my career who are more dedicated to a cause than Clovis. Once he decides what he is fighting for, little will stop him from achieving it.''"<br />"''Let us hope you are right, for all our sakes.|Bec Lawise and Padmé Amidala confer on Scipio regarding Rush Clovis|<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />}}
[[File:AtellLawise-AFIN.png|thumb|left|240px|Bec Lawise and Voe Atell represent the Separatist Parliament on Mandalore.]]
A wide-bodied Siniteen male, Bec Lawise had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and pink skin.<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> Being a member of the Separatist Parliament, he wore a set of long formal [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] to congressional events, along with an accompanying headpiece.<ref name="A Friend in Need" /><ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> As a politician, Lawise opposed the Republic and became a leading senator in the Parliament, serving in a leadership capacity as Separatist Congress Leader.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> Like many of his colleagues, Lawise campaigned for Republic recognition of the Confederacy's legitimacy, agreeing with Voe Atell's demand for such acknowledgment during the conference on Mandalore. Lawise displayed a measure of support for Count Dooku and took offense to Lux Bonteri's remarks against the Head of State, shouting down Bonteri's portrayal of Dooku as a murderer without a second thought. He did not hesitate to meet Bonteri's words with force, having the young man arrested and removed from the room despite the evident possibility of Dooku having him executed for his defiant rhetoric.<ref name="A Friend in Need" />

During the proceedings on Scipio, Lawise did not display outright hostility toward Padmé Amidala despite the fact that they were on opposing sides. He respected her favorable opinion of Rush Clovis and personally told Clovis that the Confederacy had high hopes for him. Lawise also placed his faith in the democratic process, valuing the Parliament's approval of certain matters over Dooku's schemes for power. He voiced opposition to Dooku's machinations to seize control of the banks, and his objection to Dooku's arrest of Amidala ultimately cost Lawise his life, with Dooku manipulating Amidala into shooting him.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Bec Lawise was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, first appearing in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]" on [[November 19]], [[2010]]. He was one of the first Separatist senators to be introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], being distinguishable in his position as Separatist Congress Leader. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20110803070404/http://www.starwars.com/theclonewars/guide/episode310.html accompanying episode guide] on [[StarWars.com]] first identified the character by name.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> He received a speaking role in the episode "[[A Friend in Need]]," which aired with the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] on [[January 13]], [[2012]]. He was portrayed by voice actor [[Corey Burton]], who also voiced Count Dooku in the series.<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> Burton reprised the role when Lawise appeared in the episode "[[Crisis at the Heart]]," which was released in [[March]] [[2014]] as part of the series' [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]].<ref name="Explore: Crisis at the Heart" />
